scheme_name: Bana Lutu / Handholding Scheme (formerly SEDP Agriculture)
description: The flagship program of the Government of Mizoram aimed at transforming rural livelihoods by offering financial grants, technical guidance, and direct marketing support to settled agricultural households.
benefits: Financial assistance of up to ₹50,000 per selected family for input purchases, crop diversification, and setting up small agro-enterprises.
eligibility: Permanent resident agricultural households of Mizoram practicing settled farming
Priority given to BPL families transitioning away from slash-and-burn (Jhum) cultivation
documents: Voter ID / Domicile Certificate of Mizoram
Village Council Letter / Land Settlement Certificate (LSC)
application_mode: Offline via Village Council Development Committee (VCDC) / Block Development Office

scheme_name: Mission Organic Value Chain Development for North Eastern Region (MOVCDNER-Mizoram)
description: Develops certified organic commodity clusters for signature regional crops like Mizo Chili (Bird's Eye Chili), Ginger, Turmeric, and Passion Fruit.
benefits: Financial grant of ₹45,000 per hectare spread over 3 years for organic seeds/inputs, free group NPOP/PGS organic certification, and processing equipment subsidies.
eligibility: Farmers registered under Farmer Interest Groups (FIGs) or Farmer Producer Companies (FPCs) in designated organic clusters in Mizoram
application_mode: Offline via Mizoram Organic Mission (MOM) / District Agriculture Office

description: Promotes oil palm plantations across suitable low-altitude hill slopes and valley areas to boost farmer incomes and replace unstable shifting cultivation.
benefits: 100% subsidy on high-yielding oil palm sprouts/saplings, maintenance subsidy of ₹5,200 per hectare per year for 4 years, and guaranteed fresh fruit bunch (FFB) buyback.
eligibility: Farmers holding suitable land with LSC or Village Council Allotment in designated oil palm districts of Mizoram
application_mode: Offline through District Agriculture Officer (DAO) / Oil Palm Processing Partner Offices

description: Encourages commercial flower cultivation (Anthurium, Cymbidium Orchids) and off-season vegetable farming under polyhouses and shade nets.
benefits: 50% to 75% capital subsidy for installing polyhouses, shade-net structures, and micro-irrigation systems, along with subsidized high-value planting material.
eligibility: Horticulture farmers and women SHGs residing in Mizoram with dedicated land and water access
application_mode: Offline via District Horticulture Officer (DHO) / Directorate of Horticulture

description: Provides financial subsidies on power tillers, brush cutters, mini-paddy threshers, and power weeders engineered specifically for Mizoram's steep terrain.
benefits: 50% to 80% subsidy for individual smallholders and up to 80% subsidy for establishing Custom Hiring Centers (CHCs) operated by SHGs/Cooperatives.
eligibility: Farmers owning or cultivating agricultural land in Mizoram, registered SHGs, and cooperatives
documents: Equipment Proforma Invoice from Authorized Dealer
application_mode: Online via Agmachinery Portal / Offline via District Agriculture Office

description: Provides high-quality piglet breeding stock, day-old chicks, and feed subsidies to rural families to support meat self-sufficiency and family income.
benefits: 50% to 75% subsidy on purchasing piglets/chicks, construction of pig/poultry shelters, and free animal vaccination/deworming support.
eligibility: Permanent resident families of Mizoram with space for livestock rearing
application_mode: Offline via District AH & Veterinary Officer / AH&Veti Department

scheme_name: Mizoram Dragon Fruit & Tropical Fruits Promotion Scheme
description: Supports the expansion of high-value tropical fruits like Dragon Fruit, Passion Fruit, and Mandarin Orange across well-drained hill slopes.
benefits: Subsidy up to ₹1,20,000 per hectare for concrete trellis installation, planting material, and drip irrigation setup.
eligibility: Land-owning farmers in Mizoram registering for fresh fruit orchard establishment
documents: Field Inspection Report by Horticulture Officer

scheme_name: Mizoram Fish Farmer Development Agency (FFDA) Pond Scheme
description: Supports construction of new fish ponds, renovation of existing ponds, and paddy-cum-fish culture in plain and valley areas.
benefits: 40% subsidy for General category and 60% subsidy for SC/ST/Women on constructing new fish ponds, purchasing fish seed, and fish feed.
eligibility: Individual farmers, youth groups, and cooperatives in Mizoram owning suitable land with perennial water sources
application_mode: Offline via District Fisheries Development Officer (DFDO)

scheme_name: PM-KUSUM Off-Grid Solar Pumpset Scheme (Mizoram Component)
description: Provides standalone solar-powered water pumpsets to farmers on remote hill slopes where conventional electricity grid connection is absent.
benefits: Up to 85% financial subsidy (combined central and state grant) on standalone solar water pumpsets (2 HP to 5 HP capacity).
eligibility: Farmers owning land in Mizoram with access to streams, rivers, or open wells lacking grid power
documents: Self-Declaration of No Existing Electric Pump Connection
application_mode: Offline via ZEDA (Zoram Energy Development Agency) / District Agriculture Office

scheme_name: Sloping Agricultural Land Technology (SALT) & Soil Conservation Scheme
description: Promotes SALT farming techniques, contour hedgerows, and bench terracing to prevent soil erosion, retain soil nutrients, and restore degraded hill slopes.
benefits: 80% financial subsidy for constructing terraced fields, contour bunding, and planting nitrogen-fixing hedgerow plants.
eligibility: Farmers practicing hill slope farming in Mizoram
application_mode: Offline via District Officer (Directorate of Soil & Water Conservation)
